subGoals.rule: The standing rule has one owner (backers); campaigns reach it only through the owner's published interface and never re-decide it from the backer's record (Fowler P3; Evans bounded context). The pledge cap per standing is a campaigns rule.

Closing a campaign changes no backer: the backers' records follow from the stored CampaignClosed fact delivered to the owning context, one backer per handler call (Vernon P4, eventual consistency outside the boundary).

plantedDebt.what: imports backers' BackerRepository and BackerId from its domain (cross-context internal import)

precedent: both: a clean published interface (backers index.ts BackersFacade, BackerProfile contract, campaigns acl BackersAdapter) and a stored-fact reaction (CreatorMessages subscribed to PledgeMade and CampaignClosed in the composition root); and a trap-shaped one (BackerHandles reads backers through their domain repository).
